==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will cast Blood Ritual on spell[[caster]] professions regardless of [[weapon]] type; they only cast it on [[martial]] profession targets that are carrying a [[bundle]] or wielding a caster weapon (i.e. a [[wand]] or [[staff]]).
* They will not use the skill unless the ally drops to less than half their maximum [[energy]].
{{bug|Heroes use this skill on [[overcast]] targets that cannot gain any energy.}}
